barriers.reason: The patient cannot drive until cleared, has no local caregiver (son is in Texas), and reports the nearby bus requires stairs down from the apartment plus managing a walker on board, which they are not ready for; this makes three weekly trips to the hospital rehab center unlikely to succeed as written.

alternatives.text: Ask the rehab center for a later chair time or an alternate day that matches an available ride; dialysis-style chair times are limited, so frame as a request.

Apply for ADA Paratransit certification through the Northern Illinois Transit Authority (312-663-HELP) because stairs and walker use make fixed-route bus travel unsafe; note certification is not immediate.

If covered by Medicaid or dual eligibility, call the MCO number on the back of the plan card to request non-emergency medical transport; verify coverage first since original Medicare generally does not cover routine rides.
